name: sprint05_taker_imbalance_15m
hypothesis: Extreme taker-buy share of volume (order-flow imbalance) on BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT predicts continued drift over the next 15 minutes (EFMA 2025: taker imbalance predicts crypto returns in-sample, persisting to multi-day lags); distinct mechanism from sprint02 meanrev and sprint03/04 volspike_drift, both of which failed.
power_argument: Using C0's measured net_bps dispersion (~33bp std) as the volatility proxy: at n=300 the minimum detectable edge at t=2 is ~2*33/sqrt(300)=3.8bp, far below the ~26bp T2 round-trip cost floor measured in C0/C1, so the design is powered to detect any deployable-sized edge. Expected validation trades: 2 symbols x ~92 days x cap 10/day = up to 1840 possible entries; z>1.5 imbalance events on smoothed taker-buy share occur multiple times/day on liquid pairs, comfortably clearing the 300 floor (sprint02-04 realized 1730-5888 trades under similar caps).
